blocks.heading: Terms of Use
blocks.text: Terms of UseLast updated: January 20261. About this serviceYour Accountant Match (“we”, “us”) operates a free online matching and referral service that connects individuals and businesses with independent, vetted accounting firms across Australia. We are not an accounting firm, a tax agent, or a financial services provider. We do not provide tax, accounting, or financial advice. The matched accounting firm provides all professional services to you directly and independently.2. Using this websiteBy using this website and completing our questionnaire, you agree to these Terms of Use. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information about yourself and your needs. You must not use this service for any unlawful purpose or submit false, misleading, or automated enquiries.3. The matching processBased on the information you provide, we will attempt to match you with one participating accountant from our partner network who serves your area and offers the services you selected. We do not guarantee that a match will be available, and we do not guarantee any particular outcome, result, or quality of service from the matched accountant. The matching service is free to you.4. No professional adviceInformation on this website is general in nature and does not constitute tax, accounting, or financial advice. You should not rely on it as a substitute for advice from a qualified professional. Always seek advice from the matched accountant or another qualified professional before making financial decisions.5. Your relationship with the matched accountantAny engagement between you and the matched accountant is a separate contract between you and that firm. We are not a party to that engagement and accept no liability for the advice, services, conduct, or omissions of any matched accountant. The matched accountant is responsible for the services they deliver to you.6. Privacy and dataOur handling of your personal information is explained in our Privacy Statement. By submitting the questionnaire you consent to us sharing your details with the matched accountant for the purpose of arranging the match.7. Intellectual propertyAll content on this website, including text, graphics, logos, and design, is owned by or licensed to Your Accountant Match and is protected by Australian and international intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or republish material without our prior written permission.8. Limitation of liabilityTo the maximum extent permitted by law, we exclude all liability for any loss or damage arising from your use of this website, the matching service, or any advice or services provided by a matched accountant. Where our liability cannot be excluded by law, it is limited to the extent permitted by applicable Australian consumer-protection law.9. Changes to these termsWe may update these Terms of Use from time to time. The version displayed on this page is the current version. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.10. ContactQuestions about these Terms of Use can be sent to hello@youraccountantmatch.com.au.

blocks.heading: What is Your Accountant Match?
blocks.text: A BETTER WAY TO FIND YOUR ACCOUNTANTWhat is Your Accountant Match?Your Accountant Match is a free matching service that connects Australians with accountants from our network, matched to your area and the accounting help you need.Our founder created Your Accountant Match because he saw a better way to introduce people to a local accountant than leaving them to choose from a directory listing. He brings more than 19 years of experience working closely with members of the National Tax & Accountants’ Association (NTAA) and accounting professionals across Australia.Whether you need a tax accountant, registered tax agent, bookkeeper, CPA or SMSF specialist, simply tell us what you need. We’ll find your match.
